events.title: Free Local Music
events.description: Enjoy free live music from local artists at Miami Marketta, a vibrant night market known for its street food and creative atmosphere. A great way to experience local talent in a community setting.

events.title: HOLYSTONE ~ Accepting Omega ALBUM LAUNCH
events.description: Join HOLYSTONE for the official launch of their new album, 'Accepting Omega', at the popular Mo's Desert Clubhouse. Expect an evening of original music in a venue known for its vibrant indie scene.

events.title: Rogue Traders - The Anthems - 21st Anniversary Tour
events.description: Celebrate 21 years of Rogue Traders with their 'Anthems' tour, featuring their iconic hits in an 18+ concert experience at the vibrant Miami Marketta. This is a chance to see a well-known Australian act in a lively setting.

events.title: Coolamon Singers: Mass in Time of War
events.description: Experience a powerful performance by the Coolamon Singers, presenting "Mass in Time of War," a choral work offering deep artistic and emotional resonance. Expect a refined musical experience.

events.title: Hola Marketta! Winter Festival
events.description: Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Hola Marketta! Winter Festival, featuring a mix of live music, delicious food, and creative stalls in a community-focused setting. It's an opportunity to connect and explore local culture.
